notes: Roach Modbus Tool v1.3.1 - Linux: --run-script now runs on a computer without a display (a CI runner, a server over ssh); before, it stopped at once. Updating now closes the old version the way Exit does (on Linux the old version could crash as it closed after an update). Poll: the device IP must be an IPv4 address; a host name such as localhost is refused with a reason instead of failing to connect with no explanation. Poll: Add device (+) suggests the next free port, so OK is not refused for using the same endpoint. On Linux, two paths to one serial port count as the same port. Slave: + still adds a device on the current listener with the next free Slave ID (Edit device moves it to another endpoint); asking for the connection first applies to Poll only. Slave: a refused listener names only the rule that applies (0.0.0.0 and another address on one port, or one serial port with different settings). Open Project asks to save your changes before you choose the file, and connections close only once you pick one, so Cancel keeps them running. The license key, Slave ID, Add function area and case name prompts now look like the other dialogs.
